An 8th-grade science teacher and graduate of Rutgers University, Rob Ambrose’s picture books combine his lifelong interests of dinosaurs and street art, teaching kids a classic topic in a refreshing new way. "Stickersaurs!" introduces dinosaur facts through sticker art, a form of street art that has its roots in graffiti. The book features colorful hand-drawn illustrations bu Ambrose and interactive components that capture the interest of dinosaur and street art fans of all ages. Families will be able to purchase signed copies of "Stickersaurs!" as well as copies of Ambrose’s first book, "Dino Style: Dinosaurs & Graffiti." Space is limited!
